categories.main_business_segments: Tianjin Jiuri New Materials Co., Ltd. primarily operates in two main segments: photoinitiators and photopolymerization materials (including UV coatings, inks, adhesives) and semiconductor chemical materials (including photoresists and photosensitive agents). The company is the largest domestic producer of photoinitiators in China and is expanding its semiconductor chemical materials business with a focus on photoresist raw materials and products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced chemical synthesis technologies such as acid-acid one-step continuous synthesis for photoinitiators, chlorination methods replacing bromination to reduce waste and improve safety, and high-purity benzoic acid production via melt crystallization. It has developed proprietary processes for various photoinitiators and photosensitive agents, including UV LED-compatible photoinitiators and large molecular weight photoinitiators with low odor and migration. Production emphasizes automation, continuous processing, and environmental compliance.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include downstream manufacturers of UV coatings, inks, adhesives, electronics, automotive interiors, packaging, 3D printing, and semiconductor chip manufacturers. The company serves industries such as furniture, electronics, automotive, printing, display panels, and semiconductor fabrication, with products used in both domestic and international markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Shandong, Hunan, Inner Mongolia, and Jiangsu provinces. It also has subsidiaries in Hong Kong and Japan to support overseas sales and technical services. Its sales cover major Chinese regions including East China, South China, Central China, North China, Southwest China, and export markets including the United States.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiuri New Materials operates mainly upstream and midstream in the supply chain, producing core raw materials such as photoinitiators, monomers, photosensitive agents, and photoresists. It is building a vertically integrated supply chain from raw materials to finished photoresist products, aiming for full industry chain coverage in photopolymerization and semiconductor chemical materials.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on innovation-driven growth, increasing R&D investment in photoinitiators, photopolymerization materials, and semiconductor chemicals. Key R&D directions include UV LED photoinitiators, large molecular weight and low-odor photoinitiators, environmentally friendly water-based UV materials, and advanced photoresist formulations. It also emphasizes process optimization, automation, and environmental compliance in production.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of chemical products including photoinitiators, monomers, photoresists, photosensitive agents, and related specialty chemicals. The company sells directly to end customers and through trade partners, with income derived from product sales and technical service support.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jiuri New Materials is the largest domestic photoinitiator producer in China and holds a leading position in the photopolymerization materials industry with global influence. It competes with both domestic and international chemical companies in photoinitiators and semiconductor chemicals, leveraging its comprehensive product line, strong R&D, and stable supply capabilities to maintain industry leadership.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved a record revenue of approximately RMB 1.49 billion, a 20.52% increase year-over-year. Despite a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB -53.76 million, the loss narrowed by 44.08% compared to the previous year. The company continues to invest heavily in R&D (5.52% of revenue) and expands production capacity, indicating a growth trajectory with improving profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jiuri New Materials emphasizes its comprehensive product portfolio covering a wide range of photoinitiators and semiconductor chemicals, strong proprietary technologies, and stable supply chain integration. Its products are environmentally friendly, energy-efficient, and tailored to meet stringent regulatory and customer requirements, including UV LED compatibility and low odor. The company also provides integrated technical solutions and services, enhancing customer value and fostering long-term partnerships.
